capabilities: search Zotero annotations by comment or highlighted text
search PDFs by citation and filename
insert zotero://open-pdf links with page numbers
refresh and clear the persisted Zotero cache
configure the local Zotero API URL and retrieval limit
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not autocomplete citations; it searches Zotero data and inserts links via a command-palette command.
extras: Desktop-only: it talks to Zotero Desktop over localhost only and rejects non-loopback API URLs. It reads from Zotero without modifying the library, stores a normalized cache in plugin data, and has no telemetry, accounts, or third-party requests.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to search Zotero annotations or PDFs and insert deep links to them while writing notes.

relations.evidence: Search Zotero PDF attachments and annotations from Obsidian and insert a Markdown link
For beta testing before directory approval, install BRAT from Community plugins

requires.name: Zotero 7 or newer desktop, running on the same computer with its local API enabled

summary: Searches a local Zotero library's PDF attachments and annotations and inserts zotero://open-pdf links into the current note.
